text: The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank CIMB Niaga, number 83078932117, in the name of Sterling Hygiene Group.
Late payment accrues interest of 2% per month on the overdue amount.
Every invoice must state the number of the purchase order it bills.
The Supplier may invoice only goods that the Buyer has received and recorded in a goods receipt.
Each delivery may be invoiced once only; an invoice resubmitted under the same or a different number will be rejected.
The Supplier delivers within 14 calendar days of receiving a purchase order.
Partial deliveries are allowed; the remainder is delivered and invoiced once received.
